search_boundary.searched_by: GitHub Copilot CLI at the manuscript author's direction
search_boundary.purpose: Contextualise a candidate system-steering hypothesis, not estimate prevalence or compare framework effects.
databases_or_indexes: GitHub public REST and GraphQL APIs
queries: GraphQL per repository: issues(states:OPEN), issues(states:CLOSED), issues(states:OPEN,labels:["bug"]), pullRequests(states:OPEN), pullRequests(states:MERGED), pullRequests(states:CLOSED); retrieve totalCount for each
Pinned README, agent/process, CI, parity/gap records and narrowly traced source files
search_boundary.date_limits: Live tracker state on 25 October 2026; documents retain their own historical assessment dates.
search_boundary.language_limits: Selected English-language project records; no language-complete search.
search_boundary.inclusion_scope: Public source and project reports bearing on controls, test coverage, behaviour, integration, maintenance and rivals.
search_boundary.exclusion_scope: Private standards, reporter identities/contact details, attachments, proprietary application code/assets, runtime reproduction, and an unspecified Microsoft Office clone.
known_limitations: Repositories were selected by the author after experience or perceived relevance, not sampled independently of outcomes.
Counts, paginated inventories and individual records are separate live requests, not an atomic database snapshot.
Labels/reports are not verified unique defects; open PRs are not all feature implementations or failed integrations.
Documentation describes intended practices, not their adherence or effectiveness.
Source commits do not freeze issue or PR state.
No external application or original Photoshop instance was executed.
No independent coder, controlled framework comparison, measured complexity series or systematic multi-case replication.
The author's Aithena maintainability judgement is retrospective testimony.
search_boundary.last_result_screened_or_stop_rule: All 1091 listed open PhotoCraft PR metadata records; bodies of the declared 15 bug reports and two selected PRs; all 35 open Aithena PR metadata records, six selected audit issue bodies, and bounded source traces. No exhaustive issue-body or repository-code audit.

source_locators.claim: Early-alpha Photoshop reimplementation; common command interface; explicit wiring-versus-behaviour warning.
Parity goal, layered dependencies, testing and visual-check instructions; references private external craftrules not inspected.
Layer checks, workspace tests and pinned/hash-verified corpus jobs; configurations inspected, not executed.
Menu-catalogue live-count floor, not execution of reference workflows.
is_live recognises commands, tools and UI handlers.
Historical 10 October assessment: approximately 76% feature breadth versus approximately 45% ready-for-real-work, project-defined estimates; retracts earlier surface-based optimism.
631/631 live menu items; other dimensions distinguish gaps. Performance baseline is historical and not a new benchmark.
PSD interchange and performance gaps; notes lack of opening exports in a third-party editor as an automated test; also records fixes.

bug_sample.selection: Ten newest plus five oldest open bug-labelled issues by creation time.

reported_examples.observation: Windows printing reportedly invokes Linux lp/CUPS; not reproduced.
Network-share save/close conflict prompts; reporter explicitly says the file saves, not data loss.
Reported crash opening PSD files larger than 250 MB; not reproduced.
Reported responsiveness regression plus positive workflow feedback; no instrumented comparison.

bug_sample.counter_evidence: Some sample reports have duplicate/multiple-issue/needs-info labels; some include positive feedback. No defect-rate denominator.

selected_prs.observation: Oldest listed open PR; describes GUI interaction fixes, resolution-based checks and Claude Code generation. One example, not a queue-wide delay/conflict estimate.
Open proposal to share helpers across crates; 60 changed files, 644 additions, 917 deletions at inspection. Counter-evidence to absence of consolidation, not proven behaviour preservation.

source_inconsistencies_not_used_as_measu: Photoshop corpus denominators differ between scorecard and gap records; no pooled success ratio is calculated.
Parity document header update date and historical headline assessment date differ; the 76%/45% estimates are attributed to 10 October, not 25 October.
Performance baseline predates the source snapshot and records high system load; no causal performance claim is drawn.

source_locators.claim: Human product owner, coordinator, specialist agents and work-monitor roles.
Pre-task design review and retrospectives on failure/rejection.
Documented verification and service-specific checks, not proof all sessions used them.
Local verification script; inspected, not executed.
Active preflight assertions coexist with unconditional scenario skip calls; no all-skipped suite claim.
Failure logging/persistence followed by basic_ack in finally; static inspection only, no reproduced document-loss claim.
Distributed service dependencies; configuration presence is not a maintainability measure.

selected_audit_issues.reported_concern: Failure acknowledgement and retry/dead-letter contract; callback traced narrowly.
Deployment/state coupling; not an independent vulnerability assessment.
Release/version documentation drift; not independently reproduced.
Frontend/backend upload-limit mismatch; not independently reproduced.
Skipped Phase 3 coverage; pinned source also contains active preflight tests.
Local-gate coverage omissions; no full gate-equivalence audit performed.

repositories.pr_counter_evidence: 34 of 35 open PRs labelled dependencies; sole other PR 1753 supplies Solr benchmark evidence. Queue size is not unfinished-feature count.

source_locators.claim: Human-led teams, persistent files/shared decisions/learning and explicit human accountability; not historical-version proof for Aithena.

candidate_interpretations.claim: Issue-level correction can coexist with insufficient cumulative integration and changeability feedback.
candidate_interpretations.prediction_for_a_separate_study: Under matched resources and independent cross-feature oracles, steering that acts on system-level evidence should improve unseen journeys or later changeability relative to issue-only correction.
candidate_interpretations.rival: Differences arise from oracle coverage rather than the actor or reflection process.
candidate_interpretations.disconfirming_pattern: No system-level advantage under adequate measurement, or differences vanish when oracle coverage is matched.
candidate_interpretations.indeterminate: Intervals too imprecise, unequal implementation effort, or invalid reference measurements.

candidate_interpretations.status: candidate; author-origin human-steering conjecture remains untested
candidate_interpretations.claim: Human judgement contributes something not supplied by the compared agent-only steering condition.
candidate_interpretations.prediction_for_a_separate_study: A matched-resource human-led condition improves independently specified journeys and preserves changeability relative to agent-led steering.
candidate_interpretations.rival: An agent given equivalent reference evidence, authority and budget supplies the same corrections.
candidate_interpretations.disconfirming_pattern: Agent-led steering consistently detects/corrects the same failures while preserving changeability; this weakens a human-specific necessity claim.
candidate_interpretations.indeterminate: Human/agent resources or decision rights are not comparable; no non-inferiority margin or precision plan has been set.

candidate_interpretations.claim: Tracker backlog reflects alpha-stage breadth, adoption/detection and review capacity rather than longitudinal decay.
candidate_interpretations.prediction_for_a_separate_study: After accounting for scope, reporting exposure and duplicate reports, independently sampled task behaviour improves despite a large open queue.
candidate_interpretations.rival: Previously working cross-feature journeys deteriorate as output accumulates.
candidate_interpretations.disconfirming_pattern: Reliable release-linked regressions persist under comparable scope/exposure and adequate oracles.
candidate_interpretations.indeterminate: No comparable release-level journey series or exposure denominator.

protocol_boundary: No changes to current H1-H7 hypotheses, arms, budgets, thresholds or tagged/private study kit. Future comparisons need their own prospective measurement and analysis decisions.
retention: Minimised paraphrases, identifiers and public locators only; no reporter identities, raw issue bodies, attachment contents or private standards.
